GoldenNormality.Contracts.blockSemantics (b n k : ℕ) :

GoldenNormality.Contracts.consecutiveCount (pattern text : List ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.Blocks.count pattern text = GoldenNormality.Blocks.enumeratedCount pattern text
GoldenNormality.Contracts.chunkBoundary (pattern left right : List ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.Blocks.count pattern (left ++ right) =

      GoldenNormality.Blocks.boundaryCount pattern left right
GoldenNormality.Contracts.numeralBlock (b n k : ℕ) :

  (ha : GoldenNormality.InAlphabet b pattern) :

GoldenNormality.Contracts.firstStarts (b N : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (pattern : List ℕ) (hpat : pattern ≠ [])

GoldenNormality.Contracts.wordRoundTrip (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (word : List ℕ) (ha : GoldenNormality.InAlphabet b word) :
  GoldenNormality.wordOfValue b word.length (GoldenNormality.wordValue b word) = word
GoldenNormality.Contracts.normalityWords (b : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.NormalInBase b ↔
    2 ≤ b ∧
      ∀ (pattern : List ℕ),
        pattern ≠ [] →
          GoldenNormality.InAlphabet b pattern →
            ∀ (T : ℕ),
              1 ≤ T →
                ∃ N0,

                      N0 ≤ N →
                        (b ^ pattern.length *

                            T ≤

GoldenNormality.Contracts.normalityUniformValues (b : ℕ) :

GoldenNormality.Contracts.checkpointInterpolation (b k j L N R : ℕ) (hLN : L ≤ N) (hNR : N ≤ R) :
  (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j N).dist N ≤

  (lowerDigits : GoldenNormality.DigitsAt b 0 lowerText) (upperDigits : GoldenNormality.DigitsAt b 0 upperText)

  (checkpoints :

      1 ≤ k →

          ∀ j < b ^ k,
            ∀ (T : ℕ),
              1 ≤ T → ∃ i0, ∀ (i : ℕ), i0 ≤ i → (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j (q i)).dist (q i) * T ≤ q i
GoldenNormality.Contracts.squareGeometry :
  StrictMono GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint ∧
    (∀ (i : ℕ), GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint (i + 1) - GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint i = 2 * i + 1) ∧
      ∀ (i T : ℕ),
        1 ≤ T →
          3 * T ≤ i →
            (GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint (i + 1) - GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint i) * T ≤
              GoldenNormality.squareCheckpoint i
GoldenNormality.Contracts.squareCheckpointNormality (b : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.NormalInBase b ↔
    2 ≤ b ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        1 ≤ k →
          ∀ j < b ^ k,
            ∀ (T : ℕ),
              1 ≤ T →
                ∃ i0, ∀ (i : ℕ), i0 ≤ i → (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j (i ^ 2)).dist (i ^ 2) * T ≤ i ^ 2
GoldenNormality.Contracts.squareInterval (b k j i N T : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hi : 12 * T ≤ i) (hLN : i ^ 2 ≤ N)
  (hNR : N ≤ (i + 1) ^ 2) (lower : (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j (i ^ 2)).dist (i ^ 2) * (4 * T) ≤ i ^ 2)
  (upper : (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j ((i + 1) ^ 2)).dist ((i + 1) ^ 2) * (4 * T) ≤ (i + 1) ^ 2) :
  (b ^ k * GoldenNormality.occurrences b k j N).dist N * T ≤ N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binarySquareNormality :
  (∀ (pattern : List ℕ),
      pattern ≠ [] →
        GoldenNormality.InAlphabet 2 pattern →
          ∀ (T : ℕ),
            1 ≤ T →
              ∃ i0,
                1 ≤ i0 ∧
                  ∀ (i : ℕ),
                    i0 ≤ i →
                      (2 ^ pattern.length *
                                GoldenNormality.Blocks.count pattern
                                  (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 (i ^ 2 + pattern.length - 1))).dist
                            (i ^ 2) *
                          T ≤
                        i ^ 2) ↔
    GoldenNormality.NormalInBase 2
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPrefixSparsity (N q : ℕ) (certificate : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ N) q) :
  2 * N ≤ FiniteMathKernels.binaryWeight q ^ 2 + 3 * FiniteMathKernels.binaryWeight q + 4
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPrefixHighBits (N q : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (certificate : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ N) q) : (q ^ 2 + 2 ^ N * q) / 2 ^ (N + 2) = 2 ^ (N - 2) - 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryWordOnes (word : List ℕ) (alphabet : GoldenNormality.InAlphabet 2 word) :
  FiniteMathKernels.binaryWeight (GoldenNormality.wordValue 2 word) = GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [1] word
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPowerPrefix (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ N)
    (GoldenNormality.wordValue 2 (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 N))
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPowerOnes (N : ℕ) :
  2 * N ≤
    GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [1] (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 N) ^ 2 +
        3 * GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [1] (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 N) +
      4
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryOccurrencesOnes (N : ℕ) :
  2 * N ≤ GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N ^ 2 + 3 * GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N + 4
GoldenNormality.Contracts.certifiedBinaryOnes (word : List ℕ) (digits : GoldenNormality.DigitsAt 2 0 word) :
  2 * word.length ≤ GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [1] word ^ 2 + 3 * GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [1] word + 4
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryZeroRun (start length q r : ℕ) (lower : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ start) q)
  (upper : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ (start + length)) r) (run : r = 2 ^ length * q) : length ≤ start + 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryOneRun (start length q r : ℕ) (lower : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ start) q)
  (upper : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ (start + length)) r) (run : r + 1 = 2 ^ length * (q + 1)) :
  length ≤ start + 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPowerConstantRun (start length d : ℕ)
  (run : GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits start length = List.replicate length d) : length ≤ start + 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryActualConstantRun (start length d : ℕ)
  (run : GoldenNormality.actualDigits 2 start length = List.replicate length d) : length ≤ start + 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.certifiedBinaryConstantRun (start length d : ℕ)
  (digits : GoldenNormality.DigitsAt 2 start (List.replicate length d)) : length ≤ start + 1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryWindowSymbols (start d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) :
  d ∈ GoldenNormality.actualDigits 2 start (start + 2)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryPowerWindowSymbols (start d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) :
  d ∈ GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits start (start + 2)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binarySymbolCountGrowth (start d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) :
  GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [d] (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 start) + 1 ≤
    GoldenNormality.Blocks.count [d] (GoldenNormality.BinaryAutomaton.powerDigits 0 (2 * start + 2))
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryLogarithmicCounts (m d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) :
  m ≤ GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 d (2 ^ (m + 1) - 2)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryLaterCounts (m d N : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) (hN : 2 ^ (m + 1) - 2 ≤ N) :
  m ≤ GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 d N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryCountPartition (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 0 N + GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N = N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryTwoSidedCounts (m N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ^ (m + 1) - 2 ≤ N) :
  m ≤ GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N ∧ GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N + m ≤ N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryDigitRecurrence (start d : ℕ) (hd : d < 2) :
  ∃ n, start ≤ n ∧ n < 2 * start + 2 ∧ GoldenNormality.digit 2 n = ↑d
GoldenNormality.Contracts.binaryNoConstantTail : ¬∃ start d, ∀ (n : ℕ), start ≤ n → GoldenNormality.digit 2 n = d
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementRoot :
  0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.beta ∧
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.beta < 1 ∧
      GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.beta ^ 2 - 3 * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.beta + 1 = 0
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementFloors (n : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.scaledFloor n = 2 ^ n - 1 - GoldenNormality.scaledFloor 2 n
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCertifiedFloor (n q r : ℕ)
  (certificate : GoldenNormality.PrefixCertificate (2 ^ n) q) (complement : q + r + 1 = 2 ^ n) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.scaledFloor n = ↑r
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementDigits (n : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit n = 1 - GoldenNormality.digit 2 n
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementBlocks (start length : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.blockValue start length = 2 ^ length - 1 - GoldenNormality.blockValue 2 start length
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementWords (start length : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.powerDigits start length =
      GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.actualDigits start length ∧
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.actualDigits start length =
      List.map (fun d => 1 - d) (GoldenNormality.actualDigits 2 start length)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementWordNumeral (start length : ℕ) :
  (GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.powerDigits start length).length = length ∧
    ↑(GoldenNormality.wordValue 2 (GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.powerDigits start length)) =
      GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.blockValue start length
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementValueInvolution (length j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ length) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.flipValue length j < 2 ^ length ∧
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.flipValue length (GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.flipValue length j) = j
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementBlockMatch (start length j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ length) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.blockValue start length = ↑j ↔
    GoldenNormality.blockValue 2 start length = ↑(GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.flipValue length j)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCounts (length j N : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ length) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.occurrences length j N =
    GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 length (GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.flipValue length j) N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementSingletonCounts (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.occurrences 1 1 N = GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 0 N ∧
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.occurrences 1 0 N = GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 1 N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementNormality : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.Normal ↔ GoldenNormality.NormalInBase 2
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementDigitSum (N : ℕ) :
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit i = ↑(GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 0 N)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementResidual (N : ℕ) :
  0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.prefixResidual N ∧ GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.prefixResidual N < 3 * 2 ^ N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementResidualStep (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.prefixResidual (N + 1) =
    4 * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.prefixResidual N +
        2 * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit N *
          (2 * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.scaledFloor N - 3 * 2 ^ N) +
      GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit N ^ 2
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementSquare (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.scaledFloor N ^ 2 =
    2 ^ N * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.convolutionPrefix N + GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.convolutionSuffix N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryInitial : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry 0 = -1
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryPolynomial (N : ℕ) :
  GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N =
    -2 ^ N - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.signedCoefficient i * 2 ^ (N - 1 - i)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryRecurrence (N : ℕ) :
  2 * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N =
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry (N + 1) + GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.signedCoefficient N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryBoundary (N : ℕ) :
  2 ^ N * GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N =
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.convolutionSuffix N - GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.prefixResidual N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryBounds (N : ℕ) :
  -2 ≤ GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N ∧
    GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N < ↑(GoldenNormality.occurrences 2 1 0 N)
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryZeroStep (N : ℕ) (hzero : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit N = 0)
  (hpositive : 0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry (N + 1)) : 0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryZeroGap (start length : ℕ)
  (zeros : ∀ (i : ℕ), start ≤ i → i < start + length → GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit i = 0)
  (hpositive : 0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry (start + length)) :
  0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry start
GoldenNormality.Contracts.complementCarryPositiveTrigger (N : ℕ)
  (hconvolution : 0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.convolutionCoefficient N)
  (hzero : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit N = 0) (hzero1 : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit (N + 1) = 0)
  (hzero2 : GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.digit (N + 2) = 0) : 0 < GoldenNormality.BinaryComplement.carry N
